title: The green implications of the Canada Investment Summit’s pitch book - The Hill Times
text:
OTTAWA—In Canada’s hunt for foreign capital to finance energy ambitions, the oil and gas sector looms large for the immediate future. However, the federal government is promoting a host of clean-economy projects that would help drive a transition off fossil fuels.
